title: Block Diagonal Carleson Frames
summary: We introduce \textit{block diagonal Carleson frames}, i.e. singly generated dynamical frames in which the generating operator is block diagonal. We classify all such frames when the generating operator is a direct sum of Jordan blocks, the sizes of which are uniformly bounded. Furthermore, block diagonal Carleson frames are shown to enjoy the high redundancy properties observed for Carleson frames. When the generating operator has nonnegative spectrum, we provide a complete description of the redundancy of such frames under the assumption of the existence of natural density.
